Welcome to my presentations section! 👋

Here you will find my invited talks, keynotes and selected conference presentations. Where a recording exists, it is embedded; to add one, paste a YouTube embed block under the matching heading (see the example at the bottom of this page's source).

Let's take a look... 🎥

## 2026 \| Sustainable soil science for food and water security

Invited research seminar, Department of Earth, Energy and Environment, University of Calgary. A three-theme research vision at the soil-plant-water nexus: mechanisms of soil organic matter stabilization, diagnostic scaling with spectroscopy and sensors, and adoption with Prairie producers.

## 2026 \| Kandyan home gardens and nature-based solutions

Invited lecture, Wageningen University, the Netherlands. The Kandyan home garden as a multi-storey agroforestry model and what it teaches about carbon, water and livelihoods.

## 2026 \| Livestock integration for sustainable soil and ecosystem management

Session Chair, Canadian Society of Soil Science and Canadian Society of Agronomy Joint Annual Meeting; oral presentation on recent-carbon allocation under contrasting nitrogen supply and poster on forage-management effects on SOM density fractions.

## 2025 \| ¹³C NMR of soil organic carbon under adaptive multi-paddock grazing

Oral presentation, Canadian Society of Soil Science Annual Meeting, Guelph, Ontario. Comparative solid-state ¹³C NMR study of soil organic carbon composition under adaptive multi-paddock grazing, conventional grazing and other land uses in temperate grasslands.

## 2023 \| Diagenetic formation of recalcitrant organic matter: a proton NMR study

Oral presentation, European Geosciences Union General Assembly, Vienna. Proton-NMR evidence for resistant soil organic matter formation in an organic soil profile.

## 2022 \| Solid-state NMR and DRIFTS of an organic soil profile

Oral presentations at the MOOT 33 NMR Conference (Guelph) and the Joint CSSS-Alberta Soil Science Workshop (Edmonton); posters at the AGU Fall Meeting (Chicago) and the World Congress of Soil Science (Glasgow) on molecular SOM transformation and transport.

## 2020 \| Soil organic matter and soil health

Keynote, Ontario Soil and Crop Improvement Association Annual General Meeting, London, Ontario. What soil organic matter is, what it does for soil health, and what producers can measure.

## 2019 \| Microbial carbon-use efficiency with ¹⁴C tracers

Oral and poster presentations, European Geosciences Union General Assembly, Vienna.

## Field days \| Elora Research Station

Organizer and presenter, pasture field days for producers, researchers, industry partners and producer organizations on pasture management, adaptive multi-paddock grazing and soil health.
